verdict.rationale: Letta ships an extensively documented Agent SDK (createAgent, session.send/stream, resumeSession, deployment backends, MCP tool proxying, permissions) plus an OpenAI-compatible App Server API and an ACP adapter, all of which are first-party documented public APIs for driving agents programmatically. Missing for 10: a discoverable formal OpenAPI/REST spec (probe found 404s at standard openapi.json paths) and independent third-party corroboration of API stability/usage beyond vendor docs.
